title: First Year Exploration Seminars: Improving critical thinking
description: This First Year Discovery Seminar brings university students into local K-12 classroom to improve students' understanding of critical thinking in the context of carrying out multi-day investigations. Critical thinking of K-12 and university students will be assessed before and after the course.
